title: Day 600 — Sheinbaum Holds Welfare Rally in Teapa, Tabasco; Announces 'Segundo Piso' Social Package and 24B Peso Investment
detail: On May 24, 2026 (Day 600 of her presidency), President Claudia Sheinbaum held a large public rally in Teapa, Tabasco, presenting the 'Segundo Piso del Bienestar' (Second Floor of Welfare) package — a set of new or expanded social programs building on the Cuarto Piso infrastructure established under AMLO. Key announcements: (1) SALUD CASA POR CASA: Nurses and health workers will visit elderly adults directly in their homes to provide preventive and follow-up health services — an extension of the IMSS Bienestar 'free at point of care' model. (2) UNIVERSAL HEALTH SERVICE CREDENTIAL: Mexicans will be able to access care at any IMSS, ISSSTE, or IMSS Bienestar clinic regardless of their formal affiliation or employment status, breaking the traditional segmentation of Mexico's healthcare system. (3) TWO NEW HOSPITALS: Sheinbaum announced construction of general hospitals in Teapa and Macuspana municipalities in Tabasco — part of the IMSS Bienestar expansion that has now reached 24 of 32 states. (4) PENSIÓN MUJERES BIENESTAR: The bimonthly 3,100-peso pension for women aged 60–64 (recognizing unpaid care and household work) will begin payment that week. (5) EDUCATION PROGRAMS: Rita Cetina Scholarships for secondary school students; school supply cards worth 2,500 pesos for primary school students in August 2026. (6) INFONAVIT DEBT RELIEF: 5 million families nationwide freed from unpayable housing debts; 40,000 individual Fovissste cases resolved through debt restructuring. SCALE: Sheinbaum announced a total 2026 welfare investment in Tabasco of over 24 billion pesos, benefiting 708,000 residents. The event was part of Sheinbaum's regular weekend giras (working tours) to states, which she uses to directly deliver and publicize federal social program distributions. The 'Segundo Piso' branding positions these new programs as additive layers on top of the foundational social programs (pensions, scholarships, housing) established during AMLO's 'Cuarto Piso' (First Floor). NATIONAL ACCOUNTABILITY REPORT: At the rally, Sheinbaum also announced that on May 31, 2026 — marking two years since her electoral victory in the June 2024 presidential election — she will deliver a national accountability report simultaneously broadcast to public plazas in all 32 Mexican states, framing it as a celebration and defense of the Fourth Transformation.

media.caption: Sheinbaum announces 24 billion peso welfare package for Tabasco at Day 600 Teapa rally, including home health visits, new hospitals, and pension payments for women aged 60–64

title: Day 600 — FGR Issues Formal Subpoenas to Sinaloa Governor Rocha Moya and Chihuahua Governor Maru Campos
detail: On May 24, 2026 (Day 600), the Fiscalía General de la República (FGR) issued formal subpoenas ('citatorios') to two state governors. RUBÉN ROCHA MOYA: The suspended Sinaloa governor — who took a 30-day leave of absence on May 2, 2026 after the U.S. DOJ indicted him on April 29 for alleged conspiracy with Los Chapitos to import narcotics — was subpoenaed to appear before a ministerial agent to give an 'interview' (declaración ministerial) regarding the U.S. SDNY accusations. The interview is not a formal arrest or charge under Mexican law; Rocha Moya is not in preventive detention because the FGR found insufficient evidence for an extradition arrest on April 30. Rocha Moya responded publicly: 'Soy un hombre que no tiene nada que temer' (I am a man who has nothing to fear). MARU CAMPOS: Chihuahua Governor María Eugenia Campos Galván (PAN, opposition) was summoned as a witness in the FGR's expanded investigation of the April 20, 2026 CIA-Chihuahua incident — in which two CIA agents (Richard Leiter Johnston III and John Dudley Black) died in a traffic accident while returning from an unauthorized joint narco-lab demolition with Chihuahua state investigators (AEI). Her appearance was scheduled for May 27 in Ciudad Juárez. Campos is the same governor whose 2022 bilateral security agreement with Texas Sheinbaum publicly questioned on May 23. CONTEXT: The FGR summons represent an escalation of the CIA-Chihuahua and Sinaloa cartel probe to the gubernatorial level — unprecedented in the breadth of the investigation. At her May 25 mañanera, Sheinbaum clarified that the subpoenas do not constitute formal criminal accusations and that her government 'guarantees there is no political persecution' of the summoned officials, while affirming judicial independence.

media.caption: FGR formally subpoenas Sinaloa Governor Rocha Moya (DOJ narco-ties probe) and Chihuahua Governor Maru Campos (CIA-Chihuahua witness) — governor-level FGR investigations reach unprecedented scope
